hooks.command: case "$PWD" in */.claude/worktrees/*) exit 0;; esac; count=$(ps -eo command 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^claude"); if [ "$count" -gt 1 ]; then printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"UserPromptSubmit\",\"additionalContext\":\"PARALLEL SESSIONS DETECTED (%s CLI sessions active): You MUST call EnterWorktree before editing any files if you have not already. See CLAUDE.md ALWAYS Use Worktrees section.\"}}\n" "$count"; fi

case "$PWD" in */.claude/worktrees/*) exit 0;; esac; case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" in */_bmad-output/*|*/.claude/*) exit 0;; esac; count=$(ps -eo command 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^claude"); if [ "$count" -gt 1 ]; then printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"BLOCKED: %s parallel claude sessions detected and you are NOT in a worktree. Call EnterWorktree before editing files. See CLAUDE.md.\"}}\n" "$count"; fi

if [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.secrets" ]; then source "$HOME/.secrets" 2>/dev/null && env | grep -vE "^(_|SHELL|HOME|USER|LOGNAME|PATH|TERM|PWD|OLDPWD|SHLVL|CLAUDE_)" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; fi

SYNC="$HOME/bmad-method-v6/sync-bmad-workflows.sh"; [ -x "$SYNC" ] || exit 0; stale=$("$SYNC" --check 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^STALE" || true); if [ "$stale" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"BMAD DRIFT: %s project(s) have stale workflows. Run ~/bmad-method-v6/sync-bmad-workflows.sh or /project-health."}}\n' "$stale"; fi

MEM_DIR="$HOME/.claude/projects"; issues=""; for idx in "$MEM_DIR"/*/memory/MEMORY.md; do [ -f "$idx" ] || continue; dir="$(dirname "$idx")"; proj="$(basename "$(dirname "$dir")")"; for f in "$dir"/*.md; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; bn="$(basename "$f")"; [ "$bn" = "MEMORY.md" ] && continue; if ! grep -qF "$bn" "$idx" 2>/dev/null; then issues="$issues orphan:$proj/$bn"; fi; done; done; if [ -n "$issues" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"MEMORY INTEGRITY: Orphaned files (no index entry):%s. Run /audit-memory to fix."}}\n' "$issues"; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in */.claude/*/memory/*.md) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; if grep -qiE '(password|passwd|token|secret|api.?key|bearer|credential)[[:space:]]*[:=]' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || grep -qE '(whk_|sk_|pk_|ghp_|gho_|xox[bpas]-|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9])' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || grep -qE '[A-Za-z0-9+/]{60,}' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"WARNING: Potential credential/secret detected in memory file %s. Remove it immediately and store in ~/.secrets instead."}}\n' "$FILE"; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in *.py) ruff format --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || .venv/bin/ruff format --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.svelte) npx prettier --write --log-level silent "$FILE" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0
